repositories.name: OFIS
repositories.description: Legacy multi-tenant billing/client-management platform. Source of truth for reseller/client/billing data.

repositories.name: Client Portal
repositories.description: Customer self-service backend plus CPv2/CPv3 frontends, Notifications and Zapier services. Source of truth for client-configured settings (company info, greetings, call plans).

repositories.name: Contact Centre
repositories.description: Modern backend serving live calls and call-routing decisions. Syncs data from OFIS/Client Portal via Debezium CDC into PostgreSQL.

repositories.name: QConnect
repositories.description: Twilio Flex 2.0 agent-facing UI, a customized fork of Twilio's Flex Project Template.
